title: Feasibility Study on Creating a Blockchain Based Information Platform for NGOs

ms.promise:
Brief initial report outlining the following:
1. Outcome of engagement with the government regulatory institution ie Department of Social Welfare and with Heads of NGO umbrella bodies
2. Outcome of meetings with NGO groups to present the project and obtain buy in and support from the NGO community
3. List of names of pool of NGOs numbering 100 - 120 from which the sample for the research will be determined as indicated in the proposal ie. milestone 1 bullet 4
4. List of NGOs to constitute the sample for the study and criteria for their selection
ms.criteria:
1. Initial report to provide the information listed above 
2. Pictures of meetings held with NGO groups to engage them and present the project
ms.report:
This project is a feasibility study to determine the extent to which the development of a blockchain based platform for Non-Governmental Organisations in Ghana will be successful in enhancing their collaborative effort and eliminating various challenges they currently face. 
In this milestone a number of preparatory activities were undertaken. These include:
・Engaging with the government regulatory institution ie Department of Social Welfare to obtain their support in gathering the NGO groups to enable us have meetings with them and present the project
・Meetings with NGOs to present the project and obtain the buy in and support from the NGO community
・Obtaining a list of names of of NGOs numbering 100 - 120 from which the sample for the research will be determined 
・Obtaining a list of NGOs which will constitute the sample for the study 

The acceptance criteria and proof of completion of the milestone are the submission of an initial report on preparatory activities for the feasibility study, which will provide information on the outcome of the activities listed above, as well as provide pictures of meetings held with NGO groups to engage them and present the project. 
The social media links to the first ten and last ten NGOs have been provided for public validation as requested.
The link to the initial report is: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1OCtNr_j7OLs2TC2WjnenPXouZi3lvb2H/view?usp=sharing

ms.promise:
・Qualitative google form questionnaire for gathering primary information from study sample of between 80 to 100 NGOs as stated in the proposal as follows: "The study will focus on local NGOs operating in Accra for now, and we intend to administer questionnaires to a sample size of 80 to 100 NGOs".
・Conduct of pilot study and brief report on outcome, lessons learnt and reviews made to the questionnaire (if any) – (maximum of 2 page report)
・Conduct of full study on selected sample of between 80 to 100 NGOs.
ms.criteria: Completed Google questionnaires from the study will be submitted
ms.report:
This proof of achievement provides a report which details the pilot study conducted on 15 NGOs. The study aimed at ascertaining the quality of the questionnaire and initial feedback from selected NGOs. This POA also includes extracts of completed questionnaires from the pilot study. The report has been updated with the URL for the qualitative google form questionnaire and a screenshot of original responses from the participants with the timestamp, as requested. Personal data of respondents has been blocked to comply with GDPR requirements.
Links to the report and extracts of completed google questionnaires are:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1I0P33otTNAZ831R9B1M6njpkZ_TebnB8/edit
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/16Brq73wDjPDF91nFhouplAbuJ-R8UzcC/edit?gid=1944776095#gid=1944776095
It is our belief that these will provide adequate proof that the survey was undertaken. However, we will be willing to provide further information if need be.
